about: The mutant ledger of the IR build path's coverage and agreement tooling (internal/experimental/irspike and the IR builder in internal/sketch/lower/ir*.go). Its killers need the IR toolchains or the full tier; see toolchain/ir/ports.md. Without the toolchains (ERGO_IRSPIKE_GOROOT_SOURCE, ERGO_IRSPIKE_GOROOT_IR, ERGO_IRSPIKE_CACHE) the agreement tests skip and their rows survive, so run the ledger with the toolchains set. The patch-level mutant port-stock-not-identical (a planted codegen change outside the -ergoir guard) is an edit of the Go patch, run with scripts/irport -patch, not here. The derivative's own mutants live outside this repository and are recorded here by name only (go-irspike, wf10 IR1 round 1): M1 the decoder swaps binary operands, M2 drops the else branch, M4 the IR path builds with bounds checks off (-B), all killed by TestIRMatchesSource; M6 the decoder accepts a type mismatch, killed by TestIRBodyThatDoesNotCheck; M7 (MISCOMPILE-1) the decoder's un case without the parenthesized binary operand, so Go's writer (staticBool) folds `if !(p && false)` as never taken, killed by TestIRReprosMatchSource (notand: pick gives 8, not 1) and TestIRUnaryOperandsMatchSource (seed 1). TestIRRuntimeChecks (race detector, GC checkmark) was deleted in batch-18 fix-tool: it guarded only the derivative's stack and pointer maps, and no mutant of this repository reached it.
